cases.title: CSV BOM 与 JSON 信息投影损失

hash_contract.csv_row: One-based logical data row after the header; quoted multiline cells mean this is not a physical file line.
hash_contract.excerpt_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 excerpt bytes, without Unicode normalization or newline conversion.
hash_contract.json_null: The literal text null represents a parsed JSON null, not a missing field or string.
hash_contract.record_canonical_sha256: SHA-256 of json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)).encode(utf-8).
hash_contract.verbatim_string_range: Zero-based half-open Unicode character slice [start,end) in decoded field, not a file byte range.

purpose: Deterministic source-fidelity and identity/evidence review starting points; not collaboration-match gold or identity resolution.
